text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President on Friday chaired cabinet meeting devoted to policy in the environment sector during the next five years.
- Haj pilgrimage flights from Tunisia to Saudi scheduled to start on March 28.
- President asked government to speed up publication of new hydrocarbons code giving more incentives to foreign investors.
- President recommends involving the private sector in implementing environment policy.
